title: Expected distribution
view: Shared foot base (visuals/distribution_bases/foot): skeleton of the right foot from above, then the right foot from above, from below (sole) and from its outer side; right foot.
teachingPoint: A superficial peroneal block numbs the dorsum of the foot and the dorsal toes, and the skin of the lower anterolateral leg.
claims: Skin: dorsum of the foot and dorsal toes (medial and intermediate dorsal cutaneous branches) and the distal anterolateral leg, fading in at the top.
Not shaded: the first web space (deep peroneal), the lateral border and little toe (sural), the sole. Sources: record anatomy; NYSORA.
Right foot; one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app. No bone is shaded: this nerve is not a reliable supply to the foot bones (record anatomy).
